in_hebrew.name: Doug
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Germanic: Dark Stranger
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Doug הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Doug is of Old English origin, derived from the term 'dūg,' meaning 'dark' or 'stranger'. The name was commonly used in Scotland and Ireland. In the Middle Ages, it was also given to the sons of Viking warriors, reflecting the Norse influence in Scotland and Ireland.
